content:
ana: Heads up — small canary showed a brief double-count in Console for tokens. ledger shows only one commit. anyone seen this pattern?

cho: trace id? streaming or sync? toolcall?

ana: trace=trc-zz9. streaming chat; client reconnected once. there9s a /tools/lookup call that is sometimes truncated.

mike: logs: 
[router] tr=trc-zz9 route=us-central1 -> eu-west1 (fallback)
[meter] provisional_add +65 tokens (streaming) trace=trc-zz9
[meter] provisional_add +60 tokens (streaming, after retry) trace=trc-zz9
[ledger] commit +62 tokens trace=trc-zz9

felix: Console summed both provisionals and showed ~125 tokens then never reconciled down to the committed 62.

cho: looks like provisional events had different implicit keys so Console couldn't match them to a single settle. router probably generated two different provisional ids because of model-tag differences from the toolcall.

ana: UX question: should Console auto-collapse close-in-time provisional events for same trace? that might reduce noise.

mike: better infra fix: emit a deterministic provisional_key (hash(session_id||req_digest||first_attempt_ts)) and include `toolcall_fingerprint` in the key derivation so truncated toolcalls map to the same key. ledger should emit `provisional_settle` with that key.

felix: low-effort interim: show provisional band distinct and add a small note "provisional counts may be duplicated during quick retries" with a link to the trace. but infra change is required for correct accounting.

cho: also add metric `provisional.duplicate_detected` when we see two provisional_adds for same trace within 10s; helps quantify scope.

ana: action items:
- router: deterministic provisional_key header (PR#310)
- meter: accept provisional_key + emit provisional_settle on ledger commit (PR#311)
- console: dashed provisional band + collapse heuristics + trace link (PR#312)
- observability: alert or metric for duplicate provisional spikes (PR#313)

observability-bot: created ticket PLAT-5981 and linked PR#310, PR#311, PR#312, PR#313

ana: thanks team, i'll pick up the Console UX. will follow up after PRs land.
